t: Do we need Attention? - Linear RNNs and State Space Models (SSMs) for NLP

q.x: To those curious about the tradeoffs between transformer and state space model layers, I highly recommend Sasha Rush's video on it: [link]

desc:
(More Recent version for Mamba: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dVH1dRoMPBc)

A talk for MLSys surveying recent methods using linear RNNs and State Space models to replace attention in transformer-style models.

Slides: https://github.com/srush/do-we-need-attention/blob/main/DoWeNeedAttention.pdf

This talk predates the work on Mamba, but covers foundational preliminaries. Mamba version coming soo
